ayahOccurrences.text: فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصْبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٍ وَٰحِدٍ فَٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخْرِجْ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنۢ بَقْلِهَا وَقِثَّآئِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَا ۖ قَالَ أَتَسْتَبْدِلُونَ ٱلَّذِى هُوَ أَدْنَىٰ بِٱلَّذِى هُوَ خَيْرٌ ۚ ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِصْرًا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلْتُمْ ۗ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ وَٱلْمَسْكَنَةُ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: أَمْ تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ رَسُولَكُمْ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ وَمَن يَتَبَدَّلِ ٱلْكُفْرَ بِٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ

ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُۥٓ أَزْوَٰجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَٰتٍ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٍ قَٰنِتَٰتٍ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٍ سَٰٓئِحَٰتٍ ثَيِّبَٰتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا

ayahOccurrences.text: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form II) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَبَدَّلَ is in the derivative form: بَدَّلَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ب/د/ل   b–d–l substitute, alternative, replacement
; to replace, to exchange, to alter; to trade, to barter.

Of this root, 9 forms occur 44 times in the Qur’an:
بَدَّلَ baddala 21 times; تُبَدَّلُ tubaddal 2 times; يُبْدِلُ yubdil 3 times; تَتَبَدَّلُ tatabaddal 3 times; تَبْتَدِلُ tabtadil 3 times; بَدَلٌ badal 1 time; تَبْدِيلٌ tabdıl 7 times; مُبَدِّلٌ mubaddil 3 times and اسْتِبْدَالٌ ʾistibdāl 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
بَدَّلَ baddala [v. II] I [trans.]

1 to alter, to change

(2:181) فَمَنْ بَدَّلَهُ بَعْدَمَا سَمِعَهُ فَإِنَّمَا إِثْمُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يُبَدِّلُونَهُ if anyone alters it after hearing it, the guilt will fall on those who alter it

2 to replace something, to substitute something

(76:28) وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَا أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلاً should We wish it, We could completely change their make-up [lit. their likeness, or, their constitutions] (or, change them for other creatures) II [doubly trans.]

1 to transform one thing into another

(25:70) فَأُولَئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ such people, God will change their evil deeds into good ones

2 to substitute one thing for another

(24:55) وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا and He will give them in exchange, after their fear, security

3 to exchange one thing for another

(14:28) أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ كُفْرًا have you given thought to those who exchange God’s favour for ingratitude?

entries.label: بَدَّلَ
entries.definitionHtml:
بَدَّلَ baddala [v. II] I [trans.]

1 to alter, to change

(2:181) فَمَنْ بَدَّلَهُ بَعْدَمَا سَمِعَهُ فَإِنَّمَا إِثْمُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يُبَدِّلُونَهُ if anyone alters it after hearing it, the guilt will fall on those who alter it

2 to replace something, to substitute something

(76:28) وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَا أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلاً should We wish it, We could completely change their make-up [lit. their likeness, or, their constitutions] (or, change them for other creatures) II [doubly trans.]

1 to transform one thing into another

(25:70) فَأُولَئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ such people, God will change their evil deeds into good ones

2 to substitute one thing for another

(24:55) وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا and He will give them in exchange, after their fear, security

3 to exchange one thing for another

(14:28) أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ كُفْرًا have you given thought to those who exchange God’s favour for ingratitude?

entries.label: اسْتِبْدَالٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
اسْتِبْدَالٌ ʾistibdāl [v. n.] seeking to exchange one thing for another

(4:20) وَإِنْ أَرَدْتُمُ اسْتِبْدَالَ زَوْجٍ مَكَانَ زَوْجٍ and if you wish to replace one wife with another.

entries.label: بَدَلٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
بَدَلٌ badal [n.] substitute, exchange

(18:50) أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِي وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ بِئْسَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ بَدَلا do you take him and his descendants as your allies, instead of Me, even though they are your enemies? What a bad exchange for the evil‐doers.

entries.label: تَبْدِيلاٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
تَبْدِيلاٌ tabdıl [v. n./n.]

1 the act of altering, alteration, change

(48:23) وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلا and you will find no change in God’s practices

2 the act of exchanging

(76:28) وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَا أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلا should We wish it, We would completely change their make-up [lit. their likeness, or their constitutions] (or, change them for other creatures).

entries.label: تَتَبَدَّلُ
entries.definitionHtml:
تَتَبَدَّلُ tatabaddal [imperf. of v. V trans.] to exchange

(4:2) وَءَاتُوا الْيَتَامَى أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَلاَ تَتَبَدَّلُوا الْخَبِيثَ بِالطَّيِّبِ give orphans their property and do not exchange good things for bad.

entries.label: مُبَدِّلٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُبَدِّلٌ mubaddil [act. part.] one who changes, alters

(6:115) وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدلاْ لاَ مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِهِ the word of your Lord has come to pass in truth and justice, no one can change His words.

entries.label: يَسْتَبْدِلُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يَسْتَبْدِلُ yastabdil [imperf. of v. X اسْتَبْدَلَ ʾistabdala, trans.]

1 to seek to exchange

(2:61) أَتَسْتَبْدِلُونَ الَّذِي هُوَ أَدْنَى بِالَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ would you exchange that which is better for that which is worse?

2 to put something in place of another

(9:39) وَيَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ and put others in your place.

entries.label: يُبَدَّلُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يُبَدَّلُ yubaddal [imperf. pass.]

1 to be altered, changed

(50:29) مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ the pronouncement is not changed with Me

2 to be changed into another

(14:48) يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَوَاتُ when [lit. the day when] the earth is turned into another earth, the heavens into another heaven.

entries.label: يُبْدِلُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يُبْدِلُ yubdil [imperf. of v. IV أَبْدَلَ abdala, doubly trans.] to give someone something in place of another, to replace one thing with another

(18:81) فَأَرَدْنَا أَنْ يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ زَكَاةً وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًا so we wished that their Lord should change him for them, [for one] better in purity and nearer to kindness.
